title: Photo and image credits
slide_intent: Help editors distinguish a photograph’s credit from the information required to identify a work of art and its rights holder.
strategic_value: Attributing images consistently can make the museum’s care for artists, photographers and visitors visible in its publications.
demonstration: Two copy columns explain permissions and credit lines using named examples. A Graves Gallery publication spread pairs works with small captions.
practical_value: Confirm permission and identify the photographer or the artist, title, date, medium and copyright information appropriate to the item.

content_islands.name: Permissions and photo credit
content_islands.spec: Put the permission checks and photo-credit example in the first text column.

content_islands.name: Artwork credit examples
content_islands.spec: Use the adjacent column for artwork credits with dates, media and different rights holders.

content_islands.name: Published spread
content_islands.spec: Show a gallery introduction and exhibition listings to the right. Retain the small image captions with their works.
